rows.rationale: Preserves all places, eighty men, mourning injuries, and offerings without explaining away the ruined sanctuary.
rows.before: eighty men came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria, with their beards shaved, clothes torn, and bodies cut, carrying grain offerings and incense in their hands to bring to the house of the LORD.
rows.after: eighty men came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria. Their beards were shaved, their clothes torn, and their bodies cut. They carried a grain offering and frankincense to bring to the house of the **LORD**.
rows.tsw_comparator: eighty men came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria, with their beards shaved, clothes torn, and bodies cut, carrying grain offerings and incense in their hands to bring to the house of the LORD.

rows.rationale: Retains all stored commodities and the ten men's escape from the massacre.
rows.before: But ten men among them said to Ishmael, “Do not put us to death, for we have hidden stores in the field—wheat, barley, oil, and honey.” So he refrained and did not put them to death with their brothers.
rows.after: But ten of them said to Ishmael, “Don't kill us! We have stores hidden in the fields: wheat, barley, oil, and honey.” So he held back and did not kill them with the others.
rows.tsw_comparator: But ten men among them said to Ishmael, “Do not put us to death, for we have hidden stores in the field—wheat, barley, oil, and honey.” So he refrained and did not put them to death with their brothers.

rows.rationale: Keeps the difficult association with Gedaliah and the cistern's history; note explains the uncertain phrase.
rows.before: Now the cistern into which Ishmael threw all the dead bodies of the men whom he had struck because of Gedaliah was the one King Asa had made because of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the slain.
rows.after: The cistern where Ishmael threw the bodies of the men he had killed alongside Gedaliah was the one King Asa had made because of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the slain.
rows.tsw_comparator: Now the cistern into which Ishmael threw all the dead bodies of the men whom he had struck because of Gedaliah was the one King Asa had made because of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the slain.

rows.rationale: Unpacks the long recovery clause while preserving all groups and both places.
rows.before: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies who were with him took all the remnant of the people whom they had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had struck Gedaliah son of Ahikam: men of war, women, little children, and court officials, whom he brought back from Gibeon.
rows.after: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army commanders with him gathered the people he had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after the murder of Gedaliah son of Ahikam: the men of war, women, children, and eunuchs taken from Mizpah and brought back from Gibeon.
rows.tsw_comparator: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies who were with him took all the remnant of the people whom they had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had struck Gedaliah son of Ahikam: men of war, women, little children, and court officials, whom he brought back from Gibeon.

rows.rationale: Retains the ironic challenge, repeated vows, and mouth/hand correspondence; notes feminine verb forms.
rows.before: Thus says the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel: You and your wives have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled with your hands, saying, ‘We will surely perform our vows that we vowed, to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and pour out drink offerings to her.’ Then surely establish your vows and surely perform your vows!
rows.after: This is what the **LORD** of hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘You and your wives have carried out with your hands what you said with your mouths: “We will certainly fulfill our vows to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and pour out drink offerings to her.” Go ahead, confirm your vows! Fulfill your vows!
rows.tsw_comparator: Thus says the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel: You and your wives have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled with your hands, saying, ‘We will surely perform our vows that we vowed, to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and pour out drink offerings to her.’ Then surely establish your vows and surely perform your vows!

rows.before: But a few in number who escape the sword will return from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah. Then all the remnant of Judah who came to the land of Egypt to live there as resident aliens will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.
rows.after: Only a few who escape the sword will return from Egypt to Judah. Then all the remnant of Judah who came to settle in Egypt will know whose word stands—mine or theirs.
rows.tsw_comparator: But a few in number who escape the sword will return from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah. Then all the remnant of Judah who came to the land of Egypt to live there as resident aliens will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.

rows.tsw_comparator: Then say, ‘Thus Babylon will sink and will not rise because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her, and they will become weary.’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
